name: Donut chart with labels
what: A pale ring on a dark, colour-washed ground with a text in its hole: coloured segments sweep round the ring one after another, clockwise from the bottom, and as each one closes a thin leader line draws out of it to a label of the same colour that fades in. The whole chart floats gently. Any number of segments (1 to 8) with their own sizes, labels and colours.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f21 the centre text fades in on the pale ring; four segments sweep round the ring clockwise from the bottom, each on a slow-start, long-soft-end curve (f5-f30, f44-f66, f75-f95, f113-f137); as each closes its leader line draws out of the ring (8 f: a horizontal run then a diagonal) and its label fades in over 20 f (f31, f58, f96, f135); the chart floats a few pixels from f17 to the end

tracks.name: centre text
tracks.what: the text in the ring's hole fades in

tracks.name: segment 1
tracks.what: the first segment sweeps clockwise from the bottom of the ring
tracks.easing: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0.1, 0.22, 1) (measured: slow start, long soft end)

tracks.name: label 1
tracks.what: its leader line draws out of the ring and its label fades in

tracks.name: segment 2
tracks.what: the second segment sweeps (the others follow the same way)

tracks.name: segments 3-4
tracks.what: the third and fourth segments sweep with their leaders and labels

tracks.name: float
tracks.what: the whole chart drifts a few pixels, slowly (measured wander)
